item.title: Apple Pulls MiniMax's Talkie App Over Explicit Content
item.description:
Apple removed Talkie, MiniMax's AI character chat app, from the App Store citing explicit content. The app remains available on Google Play and the web, and is popular in the US, Philippines and Mexico. The takedown highlights platform content-moderation and compliance risks for AI companion products.

item.title: Unitree CEO Forecasts China Robot Output Topping 20 Million Units in a Decade
item.description:
Unitree founder Wang Xingxing predicted at WISE2026 that China's annual robot output could surpass automobiles and exceed 20 million units within 5 to 10 years. Unitree itself shipped over 5,500 humanoid robots in 2025 with more than 6,500 units rolling off the line, while domestic industrial robot output grew 26% year on year. The forecast benchmarks against China's 34.53 million annual vehicle production to frame the long-term scale of robot mass production.

原文标题：王兴兴预测 5 至 10 年中国机器人年产量超 2000 万台

Why it matters：头部人形机器人厂商对量产规模的长期判断，附宇树实际出货数据与行业增速，具产业风向标意义。

item.title: Anthropic Completes Record $81.3B IPO
item.description:
Anthropic completed a record $81.3B IPO, with president Daniela Amodei's estimated net worth reaching $19.8B, per Forbes. Her path ran from English literature and a congressional aide role through nearly six years recruiting at Stripe and a VP post at OpenAI before co-founding Anthropic in 2021 with her brother Dario and five OpenAI colleagues.

item.title: XPeng Deploys IRON Humanoid Robot for First Public Reception Duty at Guangzhou Auto Show
item.description:
XPeng's IRON humanoid robot made its first public on-duty appearance at the 2026 Guangzhou Auto Show, handling reception, shopping-guidance and tour duties, marking its first step from demo to real-world deployment. Per the previously announced roadmap, IRON will begin in-store internships in Q1 2027, start hardware mass production in January 2027, officially launch in Q2 2027, and explore software and token subscription business models.

item.description:

item.title: Nvidia Halts Southeast Asia Server Shipments After New US Chip Rule
item.description:
The US Commerce Department issued an interim rule requiring licences for advanced AI chip exports to Southeast Asia and Brazil, prompting Nvidia to freeze related server shipments. Chinese AI labs had been renting Nvidia compute from local cloud providers in the region to sidestep direct export bans. Cloud providers now have 90 days to prove no restricted entities are among their users, though compliance mechanics remain undefined, hitting a major revenue line: Nvidia booked $104B through its Singapore unit in 2025, up 72%.

原文标题：英伟达暂停东南亚服务器出货 应对美国芯片新规

Why it matters：出口管制新规直接改变 AI 算力供应链格局，牵动英伟达千亿美元级营收与中国实验室的算力获取路径。

item.title: Sand.ai Unveils 480B Video Model MAGI-2 with Open Weights Planned
item.description:
Chinese startup Sand.ai released MAGI-2, a 480B-parameter video generation model that tops the Artificial Analysis image-to-video leaderboard at roughly one-tenth the price of comparable closed-source flagships. It supports 30-second single-shot generation, parsing of scripts up to 20,000 characters, millisecond-level shot switching, and mixing up to 20 multimodal reference assets, while showing emergent planning ability from pretraining. Sand.ai says it plans to release the model weights soon, giving the open-source video ecosystem a frontier-grade foundation.

原文标题：Sand.ai 发布 480B 视频模型 MAGI-2 并计划开源权重

Why it matters：480B 参数视频模型登顶权威榜单且承诺开放权重，兼具性能、价格与开源生态三重信号。

item.title: SQLite Ships sqlite3_rsync for Remote Database Snapshot Copies
item.description:
SQLite's built-in sqlite3_rsync copies a database snapshot to a remote machine over SSH without first creating a full local duplicate, solving the backup problem on disk-constrained instances. It borrows rsync's page-hash comparison to transfer only differing pages, so syncing an existing replica avoids retransmitting the whole database.

原文标题：SQLite 推出 sqlite3_rsync 支持远程快照复制

Why it matters：为磁盘受限环境提供免全量副本的远程快照方案，对 SQLite 运维与备份实践有直接价值。

item.title: Wispr Flow Releases Canto-2 Speech Model Cutting Error Rates 36%
item.description:
Wispr Flow has launched Canto-2, a new speech-to-text model available across Mac, Windows, iOS and Android. The company reports a 36% average reduction in transcription errors across 14 languages and over 15% for English, while accuracy on complex names and technical terms rose from 41% to 69%. Training emphasizes real-world conditions such as background noise, mobile microphones and mid-sentence reformulation.

原文标题：Wispr Flow 发布 Canto-2 语音模型 错误率降 36%

Why it matters：语音输入是 AI 落地最成熟的场景之一，Canto-2 给出了可量化的错误率与难词识别提升数据，对关注语音交互与端侧应用者具参考价值。
